# UiSpinner

An indeterminate activity indicator.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | feedback |
| Import | `import { UiSpinner } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiSpinner from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiSpinner'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/feedback/UiSpinner.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/feedback/UiSpinner.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `UiSize` | `'md'` | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible status text. Defaults to the translated "Loading". |
| `decorative` | `boolean` | `false` | Hide from assistive technology. Use when another element already reports the busy state (for example a button with `aria-busy`). |

## Attributes

The root `<span>`.

## Accessibility

- `role="status"` with a translated (or custom) label.
- `decorative` hides it when another element already reports the busy state.
- With reduced motion the ring stops spinning; the status text remains.

## Styling

- `.vui-spinner`, `.vui-spinner__ring`
- `data-size`
- inherits `color`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/FeedbackDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/FeedbackDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="flex items-center gap-4">
  <UiSpinner size="sm" />
  <UiSpinner />
  <UiSpinner size="lg" class="text-vui-secondary-text" />
</div>
```
